proof_review.judgment: Sound mathematical route: identify uu^T with InnerProductSpace.rankOne over real EuclideanSpace; matrix CStar norm equals associated CLM norm; norm_rankOne gives ||u||². Empty index carrier is harmless.
Sound route: z_(a,b)=u_a v_b and Kronecker(uu^T,vv^T)=zz^T by entry algebra; Euclidean sum-square factorizes to ||u||²||v||². Handles zero vectors and empty finite carriers.

Sound route including zero case: F=vv^T, S=sum v²>=0, K=I_m tensor F. Proves K*=K, K²=S K, CStar norm identity S||K||=||K||². If v!=0, choose nonzero coordinate and any m-index to show diagonal of K nonzero, hence ||K||!=0; cancel to get ||K||=S. Nonempty m is essential and properly scoped.

Sound direct source projection: derives d>0, r>0, L>=0 from source regime; imports exact frame norm S<=2r internally; imports integrability and actual mean identity internally; Gaussian norm-square integrability and expectation r prove retained scalar between0 andr and thus0<=a<=1. On retained branch rankone_tensor_norm yields d^-1 R S<=2rL/d; unretained branch zero. True mean norm is (a/d)S<=2r/d by identity_rankone_norm. No source ingredient promoted into public premise.

Genuine downstream consumer: uses both conjuncts of public estimate with literal integral mean; triangle norm_sub_le proves ||Z||<=2r(L+1)/d for every i,omega. Exact cosine weight has absolute value<=1, so weighted radius follows pointwise. Not a Bernstein/concentration theorem.
